capabilities: Render offline SVG previews of draw.io diagrams in code blocks and embeds
Edit diagrams in an embedded draw.io editor (bundled offline webapp or diagrams.net)
Store diagrams as uncompressed XML in .drawio, .drawio.svg, or .drawio.png files
Navigate multi-page diagrams and open embeds on named pages
Migrate old Diagrams plugin .svg files and export plain SVG/PNG images
extras: Editing is desktop-only; phones and tablets get previews only. The bundled offline editor (~145 MB webapp, one-time ~53 MB download) must be installed separately or Editor source switched to Online. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Migrate from the old Diagrams plugin — scan the vault for ordinary .svg files
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create, edit, or preview draw.io diagrams inside notes and vault files.

relations.evidence: Migrate from the old Diagrams plugin — scan the vault for ordinary .svg files
Same format as the VS Code drawio extension, so the files are interchangeable.
previews are produced by drawio's own viewer bundled into the plugin

summary: Draw.io diagram tool that embeds, previews, and edits diagrams as code blocks, .drawio files, and embeds with offline SVG rendering.
